environment: Darwin 25.5.0, node v22.22.1, script PTY, real ~/.opendesk config
privacyPolicy: Raw PTY transcripts are intentionally kept outside the repository because they may contain real user business data. This report stores only status, config facts, byte counts, and transcript hashes.

results.limitation: The local real config has no mailbox account, so this proves the mailbox TUI entry and empty/config-missing path only. Real account coverage is recorded separately in mailbox-real-account-e2e.

results.privacyBoundary: Uses a temporary OpenDesk config and a local env file for the QQ Mail authorization code. Raw PTY transcript and temp config are removed; repository evidence is redacted.

results.limitation: The local real config has no skillmgr external paths and no marketplace API key, so marketplace/authenticated install flows are not covered.

firstRunFinding.summary: The first real-config E2E run exposed an autocomplete crash in /skills and /dashboard: TypeError Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'force') at CombinedAutocompleteProvider.getSuggestions. OpenDesk now passes a compatible autocomplete options object to the migrated pi-tui provider.

remainingPrerequisites: Run Skill Manager deep E2E with configured external skills or registry credentials if marketplace flows are in release scope.
Run Channel Manager with at least one installed/enabled real channel plugin if connected channel behavior is in release scope.
Replay the original user-reported intermittent crash path when the exact reproduction steps are available.
